subject: Temporary PO waiver / prepay option for small supplier onboarding
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@microvendor.io>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@microvendor.io, elena@microvendor.io
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary no-PO intake for trial subscription

Hi Aisha,

Quick one — we're finalizing the MicroVendor pilot and Procurement flagged that Redwood requires a PO for invoices. Our finance team is small and they can't generate a full PO for a 30-day pilot. Is there any path for a temporary no-PO intake so we can start the trial next week?

We can:
- Prepay estimated spend for the first 30 days (we're OK with a 50% prepay)
- Provide W-9 and VAT certificate (if needed)
- Complete any onboarding form you require

If a formal PO is mandatory I understand — just trying to avoid a 2-week delay. Happy to sign a short addendum acknowledging prepay and billing cadence.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Head of Ops, MicroVendor
procurement@microvendor.io

Attachments: onboarding_requirements_list.xlsx (stub)

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: PrIyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: temporary no-PO intake for trial subscription

Looping you both in — MicroVendor (small vendor) is asking for a temporary waiver so they can prepay and start the pilot. Key asks: 30-day trial, 50% prepay, will provide W-9 and onboarding form. They offered to sign a short addendum.

Questions for Proc/Ops:
- Is prepay + signed addendum sufficient to bypass PO requirement for < $5k/month?
- Do we need Finance sign-off or can onboarding team accept W-9 + payment confirmation?

Proposed internal next steps:
1) If legal needs a clause, we can use a one-page addendum (I drafted requirements).
2) If Laura approves, I will send a temporary-waiver addendum to Samir and request the onboarding form + payment receipt.

Thanks — Aisha

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, PrIyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: temporary no-PO intake for trial subscription

Aisha — good signal. For small suppliers we have an established temporary path but it needs:
- Evidence: W-9 + invoice/receipt for prepay (bank confirmation)
- Signed temporary-waiver addendum (one page) that states Redwood reserves right to require PO after 30 days
- Finance needs to log a waiver in our intake tracker and cap the exposure (50% prepay OK)

I'll approve provisionally if PrIyom confirms the waiver entry and Finance will accept prepay as "payment in lieu of PO" for the pilot. PrIyom — can you add MicroVendor to the temporary-waiver queue and confirm the authority level needed? If it's under $5k we can self-approve; above that we escalate to Manager AP.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Finance Manager, Redwood Inference

> On Sat, Sep 12, 2026 at 11:03 AM Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > Looping you both in — MicroVendor (small vendor) is asking for a temporary waiver so they can prepay and start the pilot.

From: PrIyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@microvendor.io>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: elena@microvendor.io
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary no-PO intake for trial subscription — next steps

Hi Samir — thanks for the quick context and willingness to prepay. We can proceed with a temporary waiver under these conditions:

1) MicroVendor completes the attached onboarding form (microvendor_onboarding_form.pdf) and returns it signed.
2) Provide W-9 and a copy of the bank transfer (50% prepay) to finance@redwood.ai.
3) Sign the temporary-waiver addendum. I've attached a one-page addendum draft for signature (I can convert to DocuSign if you prefer).
4) We will log the waiver in our intake tracker and set an automatic reminder to require a PO after 30 days.

Once we receive the onboarding form + payment proof + signed addendum, we'll mark the account active and invoice against the prepay balance. At 30 days we'll check whether the vendor will continue under a PO requirement or transition to standard invoicing depending on spend.

Samir — attaching:
- microvendor_onboarding_form.pdf (stub)
- temporary_waiver_addendum_draft.docx (stub)

If that works, please return the attachments signed and we'll finalize.

Best,
PrIyom Das
Procurement Operations, Redwood Inference

> On Sun, 13 Sep 2026 at 09:12 AM Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > Aisha — good signal. For small suppliers we have an established temporary path but it needs evidence, signed addendum, and finance logging.
